name: CubingUSA Southern Championship 2025
information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODEyNzksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--6cfb72781a0c28a3417f66465b092596d84e5fcc/IMG_1562.webp) This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/) as the Southern [Regional Championship](https://cubingusa.org/regional) for 2025. The following states are eligible for the title of Southern Champion: - Arkansas - Louisiana - Mississippi - Oklahoma - Texas All competitors must read the [Important Information/FAQ tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2025#55871-important-information-faq) prior to registering. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
